title: Creating Authentic Power – Mastering Fear & Choosing Love
fullTitle: Soul Snack #6: Creating Authentic Power – Mastering Fear & Choosing Love
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the journey of creating authentic power, which he describes as aligning your personality with your soul and consistently choosing love over fear.
Gary guides us through the practice of emotional awareness, encouraging us to notice physical sensations associated with fear or love in our energy processing centers.
This practice gradually lessens the control fear has over us and helps us live a life of meaning and purpose, guided by love.
